data_quality.summary: CM is labeled Aug MTD but has no exact day-level data-through; it is not assumed to equal the Sales data-through date.
Brand and Power Source CM come from the overview US management summaries, while Sales uses the approved core-channel contract; compare these cuts as parallel views, not identical populations.
Lowe's / DS Common Sales is $23,510.54 versus overview Actual GMV $23,376.48, a $134.06 difference. The retained unmapped Sales row is not used to reconstruct or adjust CM.
Operating costs are labeled Aug MTD; exact day-level data-through is unknown and is not inherited from Sales.
THD / DS overview Market Insight includes the source-reported THD DFC MTD fixed spend of $612.50; the management summary is preserved without reconstruction.
Known Operating Cost Burden includes only Market Insight, Fixed Cost, Return + Warranty, and Funding. It is not CM or complete operating cost.

key_business_findings: HEALTHY PERFORMANCE — THD / DS leads Sales at $38,617.77 (45.9%), has the highest Actual CM at 37.53%, and its known operating burden rate is 7.32%.

Walmart / MP is the clearest operating anomaly: it has the lowest Sales at $5,750.92, the weakest Actual CM at -56.92%, the highest TACOS at 18.80%, and the highest known burden rate at 103.41%. These are concurrent pressures, not proof that market spend alone caused the CM result.

Lowe's / DS has the second-highest Sales at $23,510.54 and Actual CM 14.82%; its Return & Warranty Cost Rate is 11.54%, a notable contributor to current operating pressure relative to the other supported channels.

Walmart / DSV combines $16,211.64 of Sales with Actual CM 29.42%, zero TACOS, no Funding, and the lowest known burden rate at 1.00%; it is the clearest relative opportunity for further commercial review.
No supported core channel reports Funding in the current MTD management summary.
The largest negative CM gap remains Walmart / MP at -61.03 pp; the largest positive gap remains THD / DS at 30.74 pp.

weekly_takeaways: Common sell-in sales were $84,090.87 on 593 units through 2026-08-10.
THD / DS led sell-in sales at $38,617.77 (45.9%); overview Actual CM was 37.53% versus BP 6.78% (30.74 pp).
Walmart / MP had the largest negative channel CM gap at -61.03 pp (Actual -56.92%; BP 4.11%), while contributing 6.8% of current sell-in sales.
THD / DS had the largest positive channel CM gap at 30.74 pp (Actual 37.53%; BP 6.78%).
Badger contributed 93.5% of approved-core sell-in sales; the overview US brand summary reported Actual CM 2.45% versus BP -1.01% (3.46 pp).
THD DFC August MTD consumer sell-out was $28,504.78 on 35 units; recent 7D GMV was $17,040.38 versus $18,250.47 (-6.6%), and remains outside Common Sales and CM.
